description: §14.8.9 RULING S443 #7 — a bare digest (`scrml:crypto` `hash` with md5 / sha1 / sha256 / …) of a protected column stays PROTECTED: returning it is E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: §14.8.9 deriver allowlist, amended by RULING S443 #7 (user-voice-scrml.md §S443): only keyed or password-class derivers (verifyPassword, verifyHash, keyed hmac, argon2) produce a value of independent identity. An unkeyed digest of a low-entropy column is reversible by enumeration — `hash("md5", u.pin)` of a 4-digit pin falls in 10^4 tries — for the same reason `Bun.hash` was never on the list.
